def g76_collect_crossover_acc():
    import math
    execution=json.loads(read(str(g76_execution_path_acc)))
    assert execution['status']=='ALL_EIGHT_CROSSOVER_CELLS_FINISHED'and len(execution['cells'])==8
    assert [r['id']for r in execution['cells']]==[c['id']for c in g76_cells_acc]
    rows=[]
    for cell,ledger in zip(g76_cells_acc,execution['cells']):
        assert ledger['passed']is True and ledger['status']=='PASS'and ledger['exitCode']==0
        request=json.loads(read(cell['request']['path']));report=json.loads(read(cell['report']))
        source=g76_images_acc[cell['content']];slot=g76_slots_acc[cell['slot']]
        assert ledger['sequence']==cell['sequence']and ledger['content']==cell['content']and ledger['slot']==cell['slot']and ledger['block']==cell['block']
        assert ledger['immutableSource']==source and ledger['request']==cell['request']
        assert ledger['prepared']['path']==ledger['after']['path']==request['image']==slot
        assert ledger['prepared']['sha256']==ledger['after']['sha256']==source['sha256']==request['pins'][slot]
        assert ledger['prepared']['bytes']==ledger['after']['bytes']==g76_image_bytes_acc[cell['content']]
        assert ledger['prepared']['sourceSha256']==ledger['after']['sourceSha256']==g56_ref_acc(source['path'])['sha256']==source['sha256']
        assert ledger['prepared']['requestSha256']==ledger['after']['requestSha256']==report['requestSha256']==g56_ref_acc(cell['request']['path'])['sha256']==cell['request']['sha256']
        assert ledger['actualReport']['sha256']==g56_ref_acc(cell['report'])['sha256']
        assert report['status']=='PASS'and report['mode']=='js'and report['stopAfter']=='check'
        assert report['moduleCount']==17 and report['sourceDeclarations']==2954 and report['stepCounts']['expand']==263032 and report['stepCounts']['check']==1975761
        assert report['checksExcluded']==0 and report['outputPatches']==0 and report.get('output')is None
        assert report['exports']==request['exports']==g76_protocol_acc['runtime']['ABIExports']
        assert report['workerPolicy']==g76_protocol_acc['runtime']['workerPolicy']and report['limits']==g76_protocol_acc['limits']
        assert report['runtime']['versions']['node']=='23.11.0'and report['runtime']['versions']['v8']=='12.9.202.28-node.14'
        assert report['runtime']['execArgv']==g76_protocol_acc['runtime']['execArgv']and Path(report['runtime']['execPath']).resolve()==Path(g43_tools_acc['node']).resolve()
        assert len(request['inputs'])==52 and all(g56_ref_acc(p)['sha256']==h for p,h in request['inputs'].items())
        assert all(str(Path(p).resolve())==p and g56_ref_acc(p)['sha256']==h for p,h in request['pins'].items()if p!=slot)
        assert report['sourceSha256']==request['inputs'][request['root']]
        guard=report['guardian'];assert guard==ledger['guardian']and guard['status']=='PASS'and guard['ownedTreeStopped']is True and guard['timeoutMs']==600000
        assert guard['memoryLimitBytes']==8589934592 and guard['rssLimitBytes']==8589934592
        assert cell['request']['path']in guard['command']and cell['request']['sha256']in guard['command']and cell['report']in guard['command']
        phase=next(p for p in report['phases']if p['phase']=='check')
        row={k:cell[k]for k in ['id','sequence','block','slot','content']};row.update({'request':cell['request'],'report':g56_ref_acc(cell['report']),'immutableSource':source,'slotPreRun':ledger['prepared'],'slotPostRun':ledger['after'],'checkerCpuMs':phase['userCpuMs']+phase['systemCpuMs'],'checkerWallMs':phase['elapsedMs'],'footprintBytes':guard['peakFootprintBytes'],'rssBytes':guard['peakRssBytes'],'phaseMemory':[{'phase':p['phase'],**p.get('memoryEnd',{})}for p in report['phases']],'modules':17,'declarations':2954,'steps':report['stepCounts']})
        assert all(math.isfinite(row[m])and row[m]>0 for m in ['checkerCpuMs','checkerWallMs','footprintBytes','rssBytes'])
        rows.append(row)
    return rows
